entries.msgstr: Your AOND has been 3 hours. Please logout to have a rest and do some sports for your health.
You have already started the 4th hour, your game gain will be decreased to 50%. It's best for your health to logout and do some sports. Please arrange your study and living suitable.

You have been started unhealthy game time, please logout and have a rest. If you don't leave the game, it's bad for your health and your game gain will be decreased to 0. Until your AOFD is enough 5 hours, everything will be recovered.
